title: Grilled Kenyan Kebabs with Tomato Salsa
description: A flavorful and colorful dish from the great plains of Kenya. Enjoy the taste of Africa with this simple yet satisfying recipe.

ingredients.name: Kenyan kebab meat
ingredients.notes: You can use beef, chicken or lamb for this recipe

ingredients.name: Kicked pepper
ingredients.notes: Use fresh peppers for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Tomato
ingredients.notes: Any variety will do, but cherry tomatoes work best for skewers

ingredients.name: Skewers
ingredients.notes: Use wooden or metal skewers, depending on your preference

instructions: Thread the meat, pepper, and tomato onto the skewers.
Brush the skewers with oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally.
Meanwhile, prepare the tomato salsa by chopping the remaining tomatoes and mixing with a pinch of salt.
Once the skewers are cooked, serve with the tomato salsa and enjoy!
